question: How many Indians book movie tickets online every Friday?
idealClarificationQuestions: Friday tickets booked across BookMyShow + Paytm Insider + cinema chain apps? Yes — all online channels.
Tickets for shows on Friday (Friday-show tickets) regardless of booking date? Use that.
Average Friday or big-release Friday? Average Friday.

expectedLogicalStructure.label: Frame the approach
expectedLogicalStructure.description: Bottom-up: weekly cinema admission volume → Friday share → online booking share.

expectedLogicalStructure.label: Calculate
expectedLogicalStructure.description: Annual cinema admissions in India: ~900M-1B tickets (post-COVID recovery; multiplexes + single screens).

expectedLogicalStructure.label: Calculate
expectedLogicalStructure.description: Friday share (a release day, ~1.4x average day): ~3.7M tickets sold for Friday shows.

expectedLogicalStructure.label: Calculate
expectedLogicalStructure.description: Online tickets sold for Friday shows: 3.7M × 0.58 = ~2.1M tickets.

expectedLogicalStructure.label: Calculate
expectedLogicalStructure.description: Distinct users (avg 2 tickets per booking): ~1.05M unique users.
